_comment: Predefined standard comm ladder. Every generated mission uses these exact assignments so users learn ONE plan that holds across all starters. Kneeboard and briefing print this ladder. All UHF/VHF-AM values sit on the real-world 25 kHz channel raster (multiples of 0.025 MHz) so they read like assigned frequencies, not placeholders. Guard 243.000 is the international UHF emergency frequency and is fixed by regulation — do not move it.
notes: Guard 243.000 monitored (fixed UHF emergency). All agency freqs on the 25 kHz raster. Field ATC per DCS auto-assign (see kneeboard airfield page).
